caption: The drawing consists of two separate arched panels, each depicting a scenic outdoor setting using predominantly pastel colors: pink, yellow, green, and some red accents. The top panel features a man dressed in a military uniform standing next to a horse, with another horse partially visible to the right. Above the man, a banner with the words "OLD HICKORY" hangs from a tree branch. The background includes several green trees, a cluster of red and pink buildings with pointed roofs resembling a small town or village, and an American flag on the left side. The ground is green with various shrubs and plants. The sky is yellow. The bottom panel depicts a stone bridge with several arches crossing over a river or stream with pink water. A large, green tree with an arched trunk grows on the riverbank in the foreground. Behind the bridge, there is a house with visible windows and a chimney, surrounded by trees and smaller shrubs. The vegetation is mainly green, and the water, bridge, and house are shaded in red and pink, with a yellow sky in the background.
title: Bandbox
